backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the kids app backend, defining all data types (UserProfile, GameProgress, Rewards, etc.) and integrating blob storage, access control, and user approval mixins with constants for spin cooldown and trophy values.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the rewards data structure by adding a `totalTrophies` field (defaulting to 0) to all existing reward records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (spin wheel cooldown removal, prize restriction to trophies/points, trophy/points outcome logic) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing the purpose and key implementation details of pages, hooks, components, and game files in the React frontend.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'Kids Fun App' and mounting the app via the `#root` div and `main.tsx` module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that handles authentication-based routing across all pages and games, defines a centralized trial game allowlist, and gates access to restricted pages for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AchievementCeleb: A portal-based React component that displays animated confetti or fireworks celebration overlays with a message when achievements are triggered via a globally accessible `triggerAchievementCelebration` function.
A gate component that checks if the current user is approved; if not, it displays a card prompting them to request admin approval before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/AvatarP: A draggable 3D avatar preview component that renders a CSS-based avatar figure with rotation support via mouse and touch events.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/AvatarR: An empty file with no content.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/avatarV: Defines style variant mappings (color, size, type) for avatar parts (body, head, hair, pants, headwear, shoes) based on an AvatarConfig object.
frontend/src/components/craft/YouTubeHel: An empty file with no content.
Provides a global toast-style feedback system that displays animated encouraging messages/emojis in the top-right corner via a React portal, with a singleton trigger function for use anywhere in the app.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx: A reusable wrapper layout for games that renders a header with score, high score, trophy count, sound toggle, restart/back buttons, and a pet upgrade dialog.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App-wide sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation links, login/logout button, and an admin link shown conditionally based on the caller's admin status.
frontend/src/components/HomepageFeatures: Marketing landing section that renders a grid of 20 feature cards (games, stories, avatar, rewards, etc.) with icons and descriptions, plus a call-to-action button.
frontend/src/components/InstantMiniActiv: An age-gated mini-game component offering three distinct interactive games (Tap & Smile for 1–3, Match & Move for 4–6, Challenge Mode for 7–12) with canvas-based game loops and score tracking.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/ArtsMu: An interactive arts and music learning activity component supporting multiple game types (color mixing, drawing, rhythm, instruments, creative prompts) with step-based progression and scoring.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Discov: A discovery-themed learning activity component with game types covering fun facts, how-things-work, world exploration, and inventions, including integration with a backend invention stories query.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Readin: A React component that renders interactive reading and vocabulary activities (phonics, word-builder, story comprehension, spelling, vocabulary) for a given lesson, tracking score and progress with voice support.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Scienc: A React component that renders science and nature learning activities (weather, space, animal habitats, plant growth) as interactive games with scoring and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/MascotGuide.tsx: A floating mascot guide component that displays context-sensitive messages based on the current page, with optional text-to-speech support and a toggle button when hidden.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A profile creation form for kids (ages 5-12) that collects name and age, then saves the user profile via a mutation hook with default settings.
frontend/src/content/craftDiyProjects.ts: Defines a catalog of Craft & DIY projects (Art, Science, Cooking, Seasonal categories) with structured data including steps, materials, safety tips, and badges for each project.
frontend/src/content/seasonalEventStorie: Contains a dataset of 20 kid-safe seasonal stories (ages 1–12) with full story text and narration scripts including pacing and sound cues for read-along functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/usePetReaction.ts: A custom React hook that manages a temporary pet reaction state ('feed' or 'play'), auto-clearing it after 1.5 seconds and handling cleanup on unmount.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines and exports React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for backend canister interactions, along with TypeScript type definitions for all major data models used across the frontend (UserProfile, VirtualPetHub, ActivityEvent, StoryProject, VideoChannel, etc.).
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH colors, and adds utility classes for neon glow effects and 3D avatar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin-only dashboard page that displays platform statistics and activity events, and provides controls to change user statuses and add/remove feature restrictions, with access denied shown to non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/ArtGalleryPage.tsx: Art gallery page allowing authenticated users to upload image artwork (with drag-and-drop support) and view their own or public approved artwork, organized by category tabs.
frontend/src/pages/AvatarCreatorPage.tsx: Avatar customization page where users can select parts (body, head, hair, etc.) for a 3D avatar preview, randomize the configuration, and save it to their profile via a backend mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CertificatesPage.tsx: A page that allows users to generate and download achievement certificates by selecting an achievement type and entering a name, rendering the certificate onto an HTML canvas with decorative styling.
frontend/src/pages/ChatModule.tsx: A static chat UI module displaying a contacts list and message thread with hardcoded sample data, supporting emoji insertion and message sending within a parent-monitored safe chat interface.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: A real-time chat page that fetches online users and messages from the backend via React Query hooks, allowing authenticated users to send direct messages to selected peers.
frontend/src/pages/CraftDIYPage.tsx: A craft and DIY project browser page that displays filterable project cards by category, shows detailed project views with materials and steps, and lets users mark projects as completed to earn badges.
frontend/src/pages/CreativeFunHub.tsx: A hub page that displays navigation cards for four creative entertainment sub-modules (Interactive Shorts, Green Screen Fun, Karaoke Mode, Dance Challenge) and routes to them via a callback prop.
frontend/src/pages/DanceChallengePage.ts: A dance challenge page where users select a routine, step through timed dance poses with play/pause controls, and optionally enable their webcam to follow along.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that displays a searchable grid of module cards (games, videos, chat, rewards, etc.) with admin-only visibility controls based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/EventCardCreator.tsx: A card design tool allowing users to pick templates, fonts, stickers, and borders, then preview, download, or share a styled event card.
frontend/src/pages/EventCardsPage.tsx: An event card designer page with tabs for creating and viewing cards, supporting template selection, color themes, title/message input, and a download action.
frontend/src/pages/EventsModule.tsx: An events management module with a calendar view, a list of upcoming events, and a dialog form to create new events categorized by type (birthday, festival, school, etc.).
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: An events page that manages a local list of events with add/delete functionality, a date picker, and a timed notification banner for today's events fetched via a query hook.
frontend/src/pages/FeedbackPage.tsx: A feedback submission page that lets authenticated users select a feedback type, write feedback text, and optionally submit anonymously, with a list of previously submitted feedback shown alongside.
frontend/src/pages/FeedbackSystem.tsx: A standalone feedback form component with satisfaction emoji selection, feedback type dropdown, title/description fields, and anonymous submission toggle, using local state only (no backend integration).
frontend/src/pages/FunnyFartHub.tsx: An interactive fart sound board page that defines 30+ named sound entries with types and emojis, using the Web Audio API to synthesize and play various fart sound effects.
frontend/src/pages/games/AmbulanceRescue: A timed keyboard-controlled game where the player moves an ambulance to rescue randomly spawning patients on a grid before the 60-second timer runs out.
frontend/src/pages/games/BalloonPop.tsx: A click-based balloon popping game using requestAnimationFrame where balloons of normal, bonus, and penalty types float upward and the player scores points by clicking them within 60 seconds.
frontend/src/pages/games/BibbleAdventure: A simple platformer game where the player moves and jumps a character across platforms to collect coins, with gravity simulation and game-over on falling off screen.
frontend/src/pages/games/BirthdayCakeDec: A canvas-based birthday cake decorating game where players click on a cake to place emoji decorations and earn points, with a finish button that tallies a final score.
frontend/src/pages/games/BirthdayCakeMak: A step-by-step birthday cake building game where players sequentially choose a cake base shape, flavor, and number of layers, earning points at each step.
frontend/src/pages/games/BossesLearnHabi: A canvas boss fight game where the boss tracks and learns the player's recent movement patterns to predict and aim projectiles at the player's future position.
frontend/src/pages/games/BossFightOnly.t: A canvas-based boss fight game with three progressively harder bosses featuring mechanics like reversed controls and gravity reversal; the player moves and attacks with keyboard input.
frontend/src/pages/games/CatGrapplingHoo: A canvas platformer where a cat uses a click-to-aim grappling hook with physics-based swinging to collect food items while avoiding patrolling enemies.
frontend/src/pages/games/CityMovingPlatf: A canvas-based platformer game where the player jumps across rotating, vertically oscillating platforms in a scrolling city world. Tracks score based on horizontal distance traveled and ends when the player falls off-screen.
A canvas game where the player controls enemies (selected by number keys) to navigate them while an auto-moving player character tries to reach a goal. Game ends if any enemy touches the player.
frontend/src/pages/games/CronkerKontry.t: An idle/clicker resource management game where players build structures to generate gold, food, and power, purchase upgrades, earn achievements, and prestige for multipliers.
frontend/src/pages/games/DelayedControls: A canvas puzzle game where player inputs are queued and executed with a 500ms delay, requiring the player to navigate around obstacles and collect coins to reach a goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/DungeonJanitorS: A canvas game where the player moves around a dungeon to clean up debris (traps, monsters, cursed items) by walking over them, with new debris spawning over time and score based on items cleaned.
A solo space shooter game with an eclipse lighting effect where the player collects energy orbs, avoids enemies (chasers, shooters, patrols), and receives AI-generated hints based on performance. Features adaptive difficulty scaling and a high score tracker.
frontend/src/pages/games/EnemiesPlatform: A canvas-based platformer where floating enemies double as platforms; the player must land on top of enemies to use them as stepping stones to reach a goal while avoiding side/bottom collisions.
frontend/src/pages/games/EnemyControlsCa: A canvas game with an inverted mechanic where the camera follows the enemy instead of the player, forcing the player to navigate and collect coins while avoiding the enemy despite the disorienting viewport.
frontend/src/pages/games/EscapeRoomUnive: A timed escape-room puzzle game with three themed rooms (temple, space lab, haunted mansion) where the player finds items to complete each room, unlock the next, and maximize score before a 180-second countdown expires.
frontend/src/pages/games/EverythingBreak: A canvas platformer where every platform the player lands on begins breaking after contact, requiring quick movement across increasingly sparse crumbling platforms to reach the goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/EverythingIsBut: A canvas-based game where the player navigates a field of clickable buttons that trigger random actions (teleport, score changes, reveal goal). The objective is to find and reach the goal by interacting with buttons scattered across the canvas.
frontend/src/pages/games/FamousPlaces.ts: A multiple-choice quiz game that asks players to identify the country or city of famous world landmarks. Players earn points for correct answers across 8 questions, with visual feedback on correct/incorrect selections.
frontend/src/pages/games/FinalBoss.tsx: A canvas-based tower-defense style game where the player places traps (spike, fire, arrow) by clicking to stop waves of heroes from reaching and damaging the boss. Waves increase in difficulty over time.
frontend/src/pages/games/FloorIsLiar.tsx: A canvas platformer where platforms display 'SAFE' or 'DANGER' labels that may be lies, and landing on an actually-unsafe platform ends the game. Players must navigate to the goal while distrusting the platform labels.
frontend/src/pages/games/ForestNight.tsx: A top-down game set in a dark forest where the player moves within a limited visibility radius to collect coins before a 90-second timer runs out. Collecting coins slightly expands the player's visibility range.
frontend/src/pages/games/GadgetCombat.ts: A React-based gadget combat game where the player uses tools (grapple, gravity, drone, shield) to stun and capture enemies on a 2D field. Includes enemy spawning/movement, gadget cooldowns, score tracking, and game-over detection when enemies reach the player.
frontend/src/pages/games/GlitchWorldEsca: A canvas-based platformer where the player navigates platforms in normal or 'glitch' mode, which toggles which platforms are solid. Features keyboard controls, gravity physics, level progression, and score/high score tracking.
frontend/src/pages/games/GrandmaSecretAr: A canvas-based mini-game collection with three games (whack-a-mole, catch cookies, memory matching) presented through a grandma-themed arcade menu. Includes score tracking, randomized grandma encouragement messages, and per-game state initialization.
frontend/src/pages/games/InventoryIsEnem: A canvas-based game where the player collects items that slow movement and drain health based on total inventory weight, while navigating enemies to reach a goal. Features keyboard movement, item pickup/drop mechanics, and enemy collision.
frontend/src/pages/games/LiesAndTruths.t: A canvas platformer where the player must navigate safe and unsafe platforms while receiving hints that may be true or false. Includes gravity/jump physics, platform reveal on contact, level progression, and a hint system with randomized true/false statements.
frontend/src/pages/games/MemoryMatch.tsx: A card-matching memory game where players flip emoji cards to find pairs, with increasing grid sizes per level, score tracking, and high score persistence.
A room-based puzzle game where players click rooms and solve color, pattern, or sequence puzzles to unlock them, with score rewards and penalties for wrong answers.
frontend/src/pages/games/MonsterMaze.tsx: A canvas-rendered maze navigation game where the player uses arrow/WASD keys to reach an exit while avoiding moving monsters, with collision detection and win/lose states.
frontend/src/pages/games/MoveWhenBlink.t: A canvas-based game where the player can only move while in a timed 'blink' state triggered by spacebar, avoiding bouncing enemies to reach a goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/NumberRunner.ts: A lane-based runner game where math problem obstacles scroll toward the player, who must select the correct answer to clear them or face game over.
frontend/src/pages/games/OneButtonHero.t: A canvas-based game where the player uses a single button (spacebar) with tap, hold, or long-hold inputs to jump, dash, or shield against incoming obstacles, tracking score and high score.
frontend/src/pages/games/OneRoomInfinite: A canvas-based game that randomly cycles through four mini-games (dodge projectiles, collect coins, memory sequence, and platformer) in a single room, accumulating score across rounds.
frontend/src/pages/games/PacMan.tsx: A Pac-Man clone rendered on a 20x20 grid using React refs and canvas-style DOM rendering, featuring maze walls, pellets, two ghosts, lives, and keyboard controls.
frontend/src/pages/games/PauseMechanic.t: A canvas game where the player collects coins while avoiding hazards, and pressing P triggers a random pause effect (spawn, rewind, or teleport) that alters the game state.
frontend/src/pages/games/PoliceBuddyChas: A lane-based game where the player moves a police character left and right to catch falling criminals before they escape, with increasing speed as the score grows.
frontend/src/pages/games/PumpkinSmash.ts: A timed canvas-based game where the player clicks bouncing pumpkin emojis to score points within 30 seconds, with high score tracking and restart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/games/ReverseProgress: A platformer game where the player loses abilities (double jump, dash, shield, slow time) each level, navigating platforms and avoiding enemies to reach a goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/ScreenIsEnemy.t: A canvas game where the player collects coins while the screen itself fights back with random disorienting effects like shaking, shrinking, splitting, and rotating.
frontend/src/pages/games/ShapeShiftingWo: A CSS-grid-style game where the player switches between four forms (human, bird, fish, mouse) to pass different obstacle types and collect items across multiple levels.
frontend/src/pages/games/SlimeEvolutionA: A canvas arena game where the player controls a slime that can shift between forms (normal, magnet, explosive, giant) to survive against spawning enemies of varying types.
frontend/src/pages/games/SoundBasedWorld: A canvas-based game where the player navigates a dark world using sound waves emitted while moving to reveal obstacles and reach a goal. Tracks score and high score, with keyboard controls and collision detection.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpaceInvaders.t: A classic Space Invaders clone where the player shoots waves of enemies using keyboard controls, with increasing difficulty per wave, lives system, and score tracking.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpaceStationLif: A resource-management simulation game where the player picks a role (engineer, explorer, trader) and responds to random events to manage energy, materials, and credits over time.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpeedIsHealth.t: A canvas game where the player must keep moving fast to maintain health, collecting coins while avoiding obstacles; slowing down drains health and stopping causes game over.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpiderWebPuzzle: A puzzle game where the player clicks pairs of connected nodes to remove all connections and untangle a procedurally generated spider web across multiple levels.
frontend/src/pages/games/SuperpowerTrain: A side-scrolling game where the player moves a character to collect targets and avoid enemies/walls, unlocking new powers (strength, speed, flight, shield) as the score increases.
frontend/src/pages/games/SuperSpeedyRace: A lane-based racing game where the player uses arrow keys to dodge obstacles in a 3-lane road, with increasing speed every 20 points and high score tracking.
frontend/src/pages/games/Tetris.tsx: A full Tetris implementation using a canvas-style ref-based board with all 7 tetrominoes, line clearing, leveling, and a next-piece preview.
frontend/src/pages/games/ThemeParkBuilde: A click-to-place theme park management game where the player spends cash to build rides that generate income and affect visitor happiness, ending when happiness drops too low.
frontend/src/pages/games/TicTacToe.tsx: A Tic-Tac-Toe game supporting both player-vs-player and player-vs-AI modes, with an AI that tries to win, block, or take strategic positions.
frontend/src/pages/games/TimeControlAdve: A React-based game where the player navigates a 2D field, collecting coins and avoiding enemies while using time-manipulation powers (slow, freeze, rewind). Uses requestAnimationFrame for the game loop and manages enemies, projectiles, and difficulty scaling via state and refs.
frontend/src/pages/games/TimeLoopPizzaDe: A canvas-based game where the player delivers pizzas and removes obstacles within a 60-second time loop that resets repeatedly. Removed obstacles persist across loops, and the score increases with deliveries and obstacle removals.
frontend/src/pages/games/TinyHeroGiantWo: A canvas-based side-scrolling platformer where a tiny player navigates a world of oversized objects (tables, books, cups) with gravity, collision detection, and coin collection. The camera follows the player through a wide level ending at a goal object.
frontend/src/pages/games/TutorialIsVilla: A canvas-based game where the in-game tutorial character acts as the villain, spawning traps and fake harmful coins while displaying misleading instructions. The player must survive and reach the goal despite the tutorial's sabotage.
frontend/src/pages/games/WordWizard.tsx: A timed word-unscrambling game where players select shuffled letters to form the correct word within 90 seconds, earning points per letter. Tracks high score, words found, and supports skipping words.
frontend/src/pages/games/YoureLateAlways: A canvas-based mini-game where the player navigates through chaos (projectiles, fires, explosions) to reach a goal, with health, score, and level tracking.
frontend/src/pages/GamesHub.tsx: A games hub page that displays a grid of available games with icons, descriptions, and difficulty badges, supporting navigation to individual game pages and enforcing trial/locked game restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/GamesModule.tsx: A games module UI with tabbed filtering by game type (puzzle, educational, creative, action, logic), showing game cards with progress bars and high scores using static mock data.
frontend/src/pages/GreenScreenFunPage.ts: A green screen fun page that lets users upload a photo or use their camera and composite it onto a selected cartoon scene background, with a download option.
frontend/src/pages/InteractiveShortsPage: An interactive choose-your-own-adventure story page where users pick a story and make branching choices that lead to different scene outcomes.
frontend/src/pages/JokesGenerator.tsx: A client-side jokes generator with a static joke list, category filtering, favorites toggling, and mock share/audio playback actions.
frontend/src/pages/JokesPage.tsx: A jokes browsing and submission page that fetches jokes from the backend via React Query hooks, supports category filtering, star ratings, and favorites management.
frontend/src/pages/KaraokeModePage.tsx: A karaoke mode page that displays a song library of children's songs and advances through lyrics line-by-line on a timed interval when the user presses play.
frontend/src/pages/LearnHubPage.tsx: Renders the Learn Hub educational page with four subject categories (Reading, Science, Arts, Discovery), each containing lessons with difficulty levels and progress tracking. Displays category cards and navigates into individual activity components based on user selection.
frontend/src/pages/MusicRemixPage.tsx: Provides a music remix studio UI where users can adjust tempo, pitch, volume, reverb, and delay sliders, preview audio via the Web Audio API, and save remix configurations to the backend and localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/ParentalControl.tsx: Parental control dashboard with tabs for screen time limits, content filtering, and (admin-only) user approval management, integrating backend hooks for approval status and local state for settings.
frontend/src/pages/PreLoginExperiencePag: Landing page shown to unauthenticated users, offering Internet Identity login and a trial games option, with an optional redirect message displayed as a warning card.
Profile customization page allowing logged-in users to set their name, age, avatar emoji, and color theme, loading existing profile data from the backend and saving updates via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/RewardsAchievements.t: A static rewards and achievements page displaying hardcoded user points, level, badges, achievements with progress bars, and daily challenges using tabs and card components.
frontend/src/pages/RewardsPage.tsx: A dynamic rewards page that fetches real user game states, points, and badge proofs from the backend, displaying earned badges, virtual pet level, and score stats with celebration effects on badge clicks.
frontend/src/pages/ScaryHub.tsx: A Halloween-themed hub page listing spooky mini-games (Monster Maze, Spider Web Puzzle, Pumpkin Smash) with navigation, sound toggle, and a random monster surprise pop-up effect.
frontend/src/pages/SeasonalEventsPage.ts: A seasonal events page that auto-detects the current season and displays themed activities, decorations, and stories fetched from the backend, with activity completion simulation and a story reader dialog.
frontend/src/pages/SmartHubPage.tsx: A smart recommendation hub that suggests activities based on the day of the week, displays recently played items from localStorage, and uses backend game states and rewards data to personalize the experience.
frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx: A spin wheel mini-game page where users can spin to win trophies or points, with canvas-based wheel rendering, spin animation, and mutations to update the backend actor with rewards.
frontend/src/pages/StickerCreatorPage.ts: A canvas-based sticker drawing page that lets users draw with brush/eraser tools, name their sticker, and submit it for approval via a backend mutation, while also displaying already-approved stickers.
frontend/src/pages/StoryBuilderPage.tsx: A drag-and-drop story builder page where users compose multi-scene stories with characters, props, and text bubbles, saving projects to localStorage and managing them via React Query.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGenerator.tsx: A static UI prototype for a video generator featuring template selection, character picking, sticker addition, and duration settings, with placeholder preview and export buttons.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGeneratorPage.ts: A functional video generator page that takes a story, character, and background as input, generates animation frames, and plays them back on an HTML5 canvas with interpolated character movement and text overlays.
frontend/src/pages/VideoHubPage.tsx: A video hub page that displays curated YouTube channels for children aged 1-12, organized by age group, alongside craft/DIY projects with tabbed navigation and age filtering.
frontend/src/pages/VirtualPetHubPage.tsx: A virtual pet management page where users can create, name, and customize a pet with accessories, decorations, and home styles, using ICP identity and backend queries/mutations.
frontend/src/utils/avatarConfig.ts: Provides utility functions to get a default AvatarConfig and merge a partial user avatar config with defaults.
frontend/src/utils/craftVideoResolver.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, colors (including neon and sidebar palettes), border radii, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the current version, architectural notes, known issues, and feature requests focused on fixing Spin the Wheel to remove cooldowns and restrict rewards to trophies and points only.
